name: Surinabant
summary: Surinabant (SR147778) is a cannabinoid receptor type 1 antagonist developed by Sanofi-Aventis. It is being investigated as a potential treatment for nicotine addiction, to assist smoking cessation.

pharmacology.text: Surinabant (SR147778) is a cannabinoid receptor type 1 antagonist developed by Sanofi-Aventis.

uses.text: Surinabant (SR147778) is a cannabinoid receptor type 1 antagonist developed by Sanofi-Aventis. It is being investigated as a potential treatment for nicotine addiction, to assist smoking cessation.

summaryZh: 溴乙那班（英語：Surinabant；開發代號：SR147778），也譯作舒立納班或速利那班，是一種大麻素受體1拮抗劑，由賽諾菲開發。它正在被研究作為尼古丁成癮的潛在治療方法，以幫助戒煙。

sideEffects.en: Little has been published on its effects in people. Drugs of its type, CB1 blockers such as rimonabant, have caused nausea, anxiety, depression and suicidal thoughts.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它在人體的作用，已發表的資料很少。同類的CB1阻斷劑，例如利莫那班，曾造成噁心、焦慮、憂鬱與自殺念頭。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它在人体的作用，已发表的数据很少。同类的CB1阻断剂，例如利莫那班，曾造成恶心、焦虑、忧郁与自杀念头。

fact.en: It works the opposite way to THC, blocking the CB1 cannabinoid receptor. A similar blocker from the same company, rimonabant, was sold as a weight-loss drug but was withdrawn in 2008 because of depression and suicide risks.
fact.zh: 溴乙那班的作用與THC相反，會阻斷CB1大麻素受體。同一家公司的類似阻斷劑利莫那班曾作為減肥藥上市，但在2008年因憂鬱與自殺風險而下市。
fact.zhHans: 溴乙那班的作用与THC相反，会阻断CB1大麻素受体。同一家公司的类似阻断剂利莫那班曾作为减肥药上市，但在2008年因忧郁与自杀风险而下市。
